import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int[][] prob = new int[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
                prob[i][j] = (int)((long)x * mod_pow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        
        for (int i = n; i <= 5; ++i) prob[i][i] = 1;
        
        List<Integer> combos = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < 64; ++mask)
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 3)
                combos.add(mask);
        
        long[] dp1 = new long[1 << 20];
        long[] dp2 = new long[1 << 20];
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int bit = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r)
                for (int c = 0; c <= 2; ++c) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = (prod * prob[r][c]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * ((1 - prob[r][c] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++bit;
                }
            
            int comb_mask = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < combos.size(); ++idx) {
                int combo = combos.get(idx);
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k)
                    if ((combo & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                
                if ((grid[indices[0]][0] && grid[indices[1]][1] && grid[indices[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[0]][0] && grid[indices[2]][1] && grid[indices[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][0] && grid[indices[0]][1] && grid[indices[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][0] && grid[indices[2]][1] && grid[indices[0]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][0] && grid[indices[0]][1] && grid[indices[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][0] && grid[indices[1]][1] && grid[indices[0]][2]))
                    comb_mask |= (1 << idx);
            }
            
            dp1[comb_mask] = (dp1[comb_mask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int bit = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r)
                for (int c = 3; c <= 5; ++c) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = (prod * prob[r][c]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * ((1 - prob[r][c] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++bit;
                }
            
            int comb_mask = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < combos.size(); ++idx) {
                int combo = combos.get(idx);
                int complement = combo ^ 63;
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k)
                    if ((complement & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                
                if ((grid[indices[0]][3] && grid[indices[1]][4] && grid[indices[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[0]][3] && grid[indices[2]][4] && grid[indices[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][3] && grid[indices[0]][4] && grid[indices[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][3] && grid[indices[2]][4] && grid[indices[0]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][3] && grid[indices[0]][4] && grid[indices[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][3] && grid[indices[1]][4] && grid[indices[0]][5]))
                    comb_mask |= (1 << idx);
            }
            
            dp2[comb_mask] = (dp2[comb_mask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 20; ++bit)
            for (int mask = (1 << 20) - 1; mask >= 0; --mask)
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0)
                    dp2[mask] = (dp2[mask] + dp2[mask ^ (1 << bit)]) % MOD;
        
        long result = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask)
            result = (result + dp1[mask] * dp2[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ mask]) % MOD;
        
        System.out.println((1 - result + MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
